column7: structural half of classify-machine-token-un-revoke-001 (#2696): asserts both classify entry points (ClassifyMachineToken, ClassifyMachineTokenByID) persist through SetMachineIdentityCredentialClassification and that its LocalStorage body is a Where+Updates with no Save and no Select("*"); UpdateMachineIdentityCredential is named as forbidden so re-adding the deleted full-row primitive turns this red. Runs without a Postgres DSN, so the fix is guarded in the default CI leg too
